items.title: Abe Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: When I had the big band I decided to go after the best which was Martha Tilton

ctx.x: Yeah, well we’ve already taken a shot of them, so.

Oh good. This is the very first album I decided to start recording after all this, my playing at Fox and stuff. so this is myself of course and Monty Budwig, Jake Hanna, Sam was only on the one date, and Hank Jones. And Hank just fell right in. He says, “Oh, that’s what you want to do.” Because what I did, the first tune was — and that’s what set the whole thing up – “These Foolish Things” I think. He says — I just played the melody. And he says, “Oh that’s what you want.” He thought it was going to be bebop and…
Yeah, I’d love to have some.
